test_title: PYST 8: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: Z1, Z2 and Z3 can do a work in 100, 50 and 75 days respectively. All three of them began the work together but Z2 left 15 days before the completion of the work. In how many days was the work completed?
solution:
**Given:**

Z1 can do the work in 100 days.

Z2 can do the work in 50 days.

Z3 can do the work in 75 days.

Z2 left 15 days before the completion of the work.

**Formula Used:**

Work rate of Z1 = 1/100

Work rate of Z2 = 1/50

Work rate of Z3 = 1/75

Total work done = Work rate × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the total time taken to complete the work be T days.

Z2 worked for (T - 15) days.

Work done by Z1 in T days = T × (1/100)

Work done by Z2 in (T - 15) days = (T - 15) × (1/50)

Work done by Z3 in T days = T × (1/75)

Total work done = 1 (since the whole work is completed)

⇒ T/100 + (T - 15)/50 + T/75 = 1

⇒ T/100 + (T/50 - 15/50) + T/75 = 1

⇒ T/100 + T/50 - 15/50 + T/75 = 1

⇒ T/100 + 2T/100 - 15/50 + 4T/300 = 1

⇒ 3T/100 - 15/50 + 4T/300 = 1

⇒ 3T/100 - 3/10 + 4T/300 = 1

⇒ 9T/300 + 4T/300 - 3/10 = 1

⇒ 13T/300 - 3/10 = 1

⇒ 13T/300 = 1 + 3/10

⇒ 13T/300 = 10/10 + 3/10

⇒ 13T/300 = 13/10

⇒ 13T = 39

⇒ T = 30

**The work was completed in 30 days.**
